release: Local changes; no push, merge, deployment or production data mutation in this follow-up

conditional.scope: Isolated local application. Existing records read only; all mutations blocked in the browser. Unsaved selector changes and labelled intercepted failures are discarded. No production operations.

contrast.method: Rendered background pixels behind direct text-node line rectangles with glyph fill hidden but backgrounds, scrims, filters and lighting retained. Full loop frames and ambient extremes are sampled. Synthetic white/black media stress cases are labelled separately. This is not native assistive certification.
contrast.repair: Final mobile access scrim rechecked at 512,390,320; these 60 samples replace earlier rows. Other source unchanged.
limits: Finite measured samples and synthetic bright/dark bounds, not every frame or every saved layout combination.
Occluded, partly offscreen and fading text excluded.
Focus styling and forced-colors behavior verified separately in interactions.json.

production-performance.scope: Production browser lab, not real-user field metrics or physical-mobile evidence

production-performance-isolated.scope: Production browser lab, not real-user field metrics or physical-mobile evidence
